name: generic_delta_decode_grapheme_extending_scalar_value
description: Consumer path: parse a delta wire whose added/changed cells begin with a grapheme-extending scalar (U+0BD7), apply it to the held base, and confirm the recomputed root equals new_root. A decoder that splits cells or headers by grapheme cluster would merge the leading scalar with the preceding delimiter and corrupt the value (SPEC 2.4: scalars are code points).
